CustomField.label: Engagement Link
CustomField.description: The shared client link (MA_Saved_Configuration__c) this Opportunity was created from or is attached to. Set by MaAssessmentRequestController.ensureOpportunity and MaSavedConfigurationController.saveConfiguration so the relationship survives even once the Opportunity has its own life -- see Engagement_Link_Info__c for the human-readable, clickable version shown on the page layout.
